name: Josh Gottheimer
committees: House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence
stance: Wants federal security standards for deploying AI agents after rogue-agent incidents.

statements.text: Introduced the Stop Rogue AI Act with Rep. Lawler, directing NIST to publish standards for securely deploying AI agents.
Right now, AI agents are running loose in our networks, and nobody can see them or verify who built them — making it increasingly hard to stop them. That's a five-alarm security risk.
